title: pdf_prebake prints FAILED but exits 0 — failed regeneration looks successful to any script
evidence:
case failures {
    0 ->
      io.println(
        "Pre-baked "
        <> int_to_string(list.length(results))
        <> " demo report PDFs into "
        <> out_dir,
      )
    _ ->
      io.println(
        "FAILED: "
        <> int_to_string(failures)
        <> " of "
        <> int_to_string(list.length(results))
        <> " PDFs failed",
      )
  }
detail: On generate/write failure the tool only prints 'FAILED: n of m PDFs failed' and returns normally — no halt/non-zero exit anywhere in the file (imports confirm no erlang halt). A scripted or inattentive regeneration exits 0 with stale or missing static PDFs.
recommended_fix: Call halt(1) (e.g. via gleam/erlang halt or an FFI) in the non-zero failures branch so a failed bake fails the calling process.

title: Documented priv-dir CLI argument is silently ignored — regeneration from repo root writes to the wrong tree
detail: The header documents a priv-dir argument, but main() hardcodes priv_dir = "priv" and never reads argv. Run from the repo root with the documented 'server/priv' arg, it creates <root>/priv/static/demo and writes there; the shipped PDFs under server/priv stay stale with no error.
recommended_fix: Read the priv dir from argv (erlang start arguments) falling back to "priv", or drop the argument from the doc comment.

title: No-network lint only scans client/src/demo/ — demo-only module demo_banner.gleam lives outside the linted directory
evidence:
VIOLATIONS=$(grep -rn "rsvp\|api_helpers" client/src/demo/ --include="*.gleam" || true)
...
          FETCH_VIOLATIONS=$(grep -rln "gleam/fetch" client/src/demo/ --include="*.gleam" | grep -v "demo_api.gleam" || true)
detail: The lint is the structural guard for the non-persistence pillar, but demo chrome ships in client/src/components/demo_banner.gleam (verified present) and demo branches live in client.gleam — all outside client/src/demo/. A future network import in either would evade the guard silently.
recommended_fix: Extend the grep paths to include client/src/components/demo_banner.gleam (and any future demo-* modules), or move demo chrome under client/src/demo/.
